description:
## Why

Beads have the same Category-A / B / C mix as source files. Walk open beads, strip Category-A language from descriptions. Walk deferred-status beads, revive the ones deferred for Category-A reasons.

## What

### Bead description sweep

For every open or in-progress bead (≈36 of them as of 2026-05-11):
1. Read the description.
2. Identify Category-A language ('out of scope for v0.1', 'tracked for v0.2', 'planned for v0.3', 'deferred to v0.x').
3. Rewrite to describe current state without version gating, OR strip if the sentence reduces to nothing useful.
4. Keep '## Out of scope' sections that are Category B (legitimate work-partition, e.g. 'consumer's job', 'handled by pkix-X', 'separate RFC').
5. Keep '## Out of scope' sections that are Category C ("this bead does NOT cover Y because Y is its own bead") — these are work-partition, not version-gate.

### Deferred-status revival

Per 2026-05-11 `bd list --status=deferred`, 11 beads are deferred. Category-A revival candidates:

- **PKIX-r2y** — 'v0.2: max_rdn_size policy limit in ValidationPolicy' — REVIVE.
- **PKIX-zyb** — 'v0.2: Unicode NFKC normalization in names_match' — REVIVE.

Leave deferred (legit non-version-gate reasons):
- PKIX-taa.10 (DoS vector — operational risk decision)
- PKIX-2j0.2/5/6/8 (perf cleanups)
- PKIX-gr9.3 (#[must_use] inheritance)
- PKIX-taa.7 (wrong test assertions)
- PKIX-taa.8 (duplicate tests)
- PKIX-taa.9 (depth counting discrepancy)

Verify each by reading the bead description before final decision; reclassify if grep was wrong.

### Title 'deferred' check

Two blocked-status beads have '(deferred)' in title:
- **PKIX-klku** — 'diff harness: CI integration (deferred)'
- **PKIX-5bab** — 'diff harness: Tier-3 CT log scrape corpus (deferred)'

Read each. If 'deferred' = Category A (version-gate), strip the qualifier and check if the bead becomes workable. If 'deferred' = Category B/C (legitimate sequencing, blocked on another concrete piece of work), leave alone.

### PKIX-t0w4 reframe

With the v0.1 path-building gate dropped and `pkix-path-builder` crate already existing:
- Original Option 1 (in-harness AKI/SKI walk) becomes 'tactical, throwaway'.
- Original Option 2 ('stand up pkix-path-builder') becomes 'use existing pkix-path-builder'.
- Original Option 3 ('accept noise') stays available but lower priority now that path-building IS in scope.

Update PKIX-t0w4's description to reflect the new options without forcing a decision in this bead — surface for human review separately if Mark wants to choose now.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Every open/in-progress bead's description scanned. Category-A language removed or reframed.
- [ ] PKIX-r2y, PKIX-zyb revived to open status with rewritten descriptions (no v0.2 framing).
- [ ] PKIX-klku, PKIX-5bab triaged: either qualifier stripped + un-deferred, or leave with reason recorded.
- [ ] PKIX-t0w4 description reframed for pkix-path-builder reality.
- [ ] Final `bd search 'v0.2'` and `bd search 'v0.3'` return zero results that are Category A.

## Out of scope (Category B usage, correctly!)

- Code/docs sweep — that's PKIX-agp7.2.
- AGENTS.md / CHANGELOG — that's PKIX-agp7.1.
- Closed beads — historical record, leave alone.

## Depends on

PKIX-agp7.1 (anchor first; .2 and .3 are independent and can run in parallel after .1).
title: Sweep Category-A version-gating from bead descriptions; un-defer Category-A deferred beads
